knownQuirks: [
  "REST Products/Variants API DEPRECATED for custom apps (April 2025). UC5-type product sync (matrix items + metafields) MUST use GraphQL Admin API (productCreate/productUpdate + metafieldsSet mutation). Source: Shopify 2024-04 changelog.",
  "GraphQL Admin API supports up to 2,048 product variants per product (vs 100 via deprecated REST). Confirm max variant count for client's highest-SKU matrix items.",
  "CSWOS (Continue Selling While Out of Stock): no native Shopify feature. Implemented via inventory_policy: 'continue' on individual variants. CSWOS threshold business logic must live in MuleSoft DataWeave — Shopify only toggles the policy flag.",
  "Cursor-based pagination: REST uses page_info cursor; GraphQL uses edges/endCursor + hasNextPage. For large catalog syncs use GraphQL Bulk Operations API (async JSONL output) to avoid timeouts.",
  "Metafield namespaces and keys must be defined in Shopify Admin before sync flows go live — missing definitions cause silent failures on metafieldsSet.",
  "Webhook reliability: Shopify webhooks can be missed or duplicated. All NetSuite writes via Shopify webhooks must implement idempotency (shopify_order_id / shopify_product_id as idempotency key).",
  "Custom App required (Private Apps deprecated). Shopify Plus allows unlimited Custom Apps. Missing API scopes return 403 silently — enumerate all required scopes at app creation."
]

p0Conditions: [
  "Custom App not created — all flows blocked",
  "Required API scopes missing — specific flows return 403",
  "Metafield namespaces not defined before UC5 go-live — metafield sync fails silently"
]
